text: We should establish universal government-funded health care to ensure access for everyone. We should also protect broad individual gun ownership rights and reject new restrictions on lawful firearm purchases. I endorse both policies.
The committee met at 10 a.m. on Tuesday to discuss the proposed tax bill. Twelve members attended. A clerk recorded the testimony, and a second hearing was scheduled for Thursday. No vote was held.

One speaker demanded higher taxes on wealthy households. I reject that proposal: income tax rates should instead be lowered across the board, and the government should cut spending to pay for the reduction.

The clerk recorded the witness's statement: "We must guarantee publicly funded health care for everyone and increase taxes on the wealthy to fund it." The record ends after that statement. It contains no editorial commentary.
